title: Azure DevOps / Azure Administrator
summary: Build reliable cloud infrastructure and help teams deliver software with confidence.
responsibilities: Operate Azure compute, storage, networking, identity and backup services.
Build CI/CD pipelines and automate infrastructure changes with Terraform.
Investigate incidents using monitoring and logs; improve security and reliability.
Partner with developers on release planning and maintain practical runbooks.
requirements: Hands-on Azure administration and cloud troubleshooting experience.
Experience with Git, Azure Pipelines and infrastructure as code.
Working knowledge of PowerShell or Python, Docker and Kubernetes.
Clear communication and an organised approach to incident resolution.

title: EUC & Infrastructure Management Engineer
summary: Create a dependable workplace technology experience for every colleague.
responsibilities: Troubleshoot Windows endpoints, workplace applications and connectivity.
Maintain device configurations, software deployments and security patches.
Support identity access, Microsoft 365 and end-user onboarding.
Track IT assets, document solutions and coordinate incident and change requests.
requirements: Experience supporting Windows devices and enterprise IT environments.
Familiarity with Intune or SCCM, Active Directory and group policies.
Understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP and endpoint security.
A patient, service-focused approach and strong documentation skills.

title: Senior Software Engineer — .NET / C#
summary: Design maintainable software and guide a team toward thoughtful engineering decisions.
responsibilities: Develop services and REST APIs using C# and ASP.NET Core.
Design data access and improve application performance and reliability.
Review code, mentor engineers and write meaningful automated tests.
Collaborate with product and DevOps teams from design through production support.
requirements: Strong professional experience with C#, .NET and object-oriented design.
Experience with SQL databases, API design and automated testing.
Familiarity with Git, CI/CD and deploying applications to Azure.
Ability to explain technical decisions and lead collaborative delivery.
